summary: Independent follow-on audit in the degree-fork arena, preserving completed ATTEMPT-QUARTA-VIA-DEGREE-FORK-AUDIT and its source findings. Read the exact grades-to-maximum dossier and existing GradesByApproachToAMaximumReading, GradesFoundInThingsReading and QuartaViaUnboundedDegrees types. Accepted the frozen QuartaViaUnboundedCore Challenge (SHA256 e4b043f2f7dff095a662b8de6d38399d25018208d4f97a759ce9e739012eb1c7), direct Solution, canonical argument/result prose and definition/disambiguation links. Exactly three explicit hypotheses are used: the global grades-to-maximum conditional, existing observed grades, and strict degree extension at esse. Observed grades supply a member a of Being, not a comparison at esse; extension at a supplies that comparison, the maximum conditional at esse supplies m, and extension at m contradicts actual maximality. No homogeneous-scale, Preorder/totality, genus-causality, causal-ascent, causal-edge, identity, implicit Nonempty or excluded-middle assumption is used by the main proof. This is useful conditional discrimination of the previously witnessed unbounded branch against an existing root-path maximum-existence commitment; it is not a new philosophical refutation, establishment of that commitment or selection of a preferred member for rejection. No new rival or source claim is attributed. Stronger scope boundary: the maximum principle plus extension alone imply that Being has no member (for any supplied member the same comparison/maximum/extension argument yields False). They are therefore satisfiable together on Empty and are not an unconditional two-premise contradiction. The already frozen core was preserved rather than enlarged with that stronger consequence. Observed grades are used only as a population-supplying premise and are stronger than bare population; no weakest-background or absolute minimum-premise claim follows. Independently inspected all three exact closed single-deletion controls and their underlying model helpers. withoutUnbounded uses one Boolean finite-top interpretation satisfying maximum and grades and violating extension. withoutMaximumPrinciple uses one Nat interpretation satisfying grades and extension and violating the maximum principle; it does not combine a motion/grade witness from a different model. withoutGrades uses one Empty-being/Unit-respect interpretation with the two universal propositions vacuously true and observed grades false. This is a typed omission control, not a nonempty rival theory or a metaphysically possible empty world. All three conjunctions explicitly violate the omitted target while keeping the other two in the same interpretation. These exact controls can support deletion-minimality among the named three after their Comparator/NanoDa checks; they are distinct from automatic finite-registry-computed minimality and do not establish minimum cardinality among arbitrary formalizations. The existing finite registry rejects empty carrier enumerations and infinite Nat is outside its scope. A minimal empty-enumeration extension was considered (it would need an exact kernel-checked forall x:Being, False certificate, not merely removal of the validator restriction) and deliberately not pursued: Empty support alone would still leave Nat unregistered and would not complete automatic minimality. This is a scoped workflow choice, not an owner blocker. No unsupported Empty/Nat registration or computed-minimality claim is made. The Comparator configuration includes the core and all three frozen omission obligations with the authorized Mathlib axiom profile because the Nat helper reuses prior classical Mathlib evidence; this is not a claim that the main structural proof needs excluded middle. No semantic/type finding remains in the inspected source and records. Final exact-input build/binding/Comparator/NanoDa and integration checks remain coordinator-owned. Actual root-premise delta: none.
